nodes.description: Array of AggregatorV3Interface oracle feeds (dai/usdc/usdt/tusd to ETH), pushable by admin.
AggregatorV3Interface oracle for ETH/USD used as second price leg.
IAdmin contract instance that decides who may add price feeds.
Deploys the contract, populates price feed array and sets admin from constructor argument.
Admin-only function that pushes an attacker-supplied oracle address into priceFeed.
View function reading two Chainlink oracles and returning price scaled by 1e18.
Overflow-checked multiplication helper used for price math.
Division-by-zero-checked division helper used to scale the price by 1e18.
Caller address, used as the only authorization input in addPriceFeed.
External call admin.admin() used inside the require guard; returns an untrusted admin address from another contract.
State-mutating push of a new oracle address into the priceFeed array.
External oracle read priceFeed[idx].latestRoundData(); returned answer/timestamps are unvalidated beyond non-zero.
External oracle read of the ETH/USD feed; answer/timestamps unchecked for staleness.
Expression uint(priceETH).mul(uint(priceUSD)).div(1e18) combining two oracle answers; int256->uint256 casts on feed data.
Constructor parameter holding the IAdmin contract address.
addPriceFeed parameter, the oracle address to be registered.
getLatestPrice parameter selecting which feed in priceFeed to query.
Local int256 answer returned by priceFeed[idx].latestRoundData().
Local uint updatedAt timestamp returned by priceFeed[idx].latestRoundData().
Local int256 answer returned by priceFeedETHToUSD.latestRoundData().
Local uint updatedAt timestamp returned by priceFeedETHToUSD.latestRoundData().

edges.reason: Constructor argument adminAddress is written to the admin state variable, making authorization externally controlled.
Constructor sets the admin IAdmin instance.
Constructor populates the priceFeed array with four hardcoded oracles.
Constructor assigns the ETH/USD oracle to priceFeedETHToUSD.
msg.sender is compared with the return value of admin.admin() in the require guard.
The admin state variable supplies the external contract that is queried for the authorization decision.
require(msg.sender == admin.admin()) gates execution of priceFeed.push.
addPriceFeed performs the external admin check before mutating state.
addPriceFeed pushes the supplied oracle into the priceFeed array.
The addr parameter is pushed into priceFeed, letting the caller choose an arbitrary oracle contract.
getLatestPrice queries priceFeed[idx].latestRoundData().
getLatestPrice queries the ETH/USD feed via latestRoundData().
The priceFeed array is indexed to obtain the oracle being called.
The idx parameter selects which oracle in priceFeed is called.
The priceFeedETHToUSD state variable is the oracle being called.
The oracle answer of the selected feed is stored in local priceETH.
The oracle updatedAt value is stored in local timeStampETH.
The ETH/USD oracle answer is stored in local priceUSD.
The ETH/USD oracle updatedAt value is stored in local timeStampUSD.
priceETH is cast to uint256 and multiplied into the price expression.
priceUSD is cast to uint256 and multiplied into the price expression.
getLatestPrice calls SafeMath.mul for the price multiplication step.
getLatestPrice calls SafeMath.div to scale the product by 1e18.
The computed price expression is returned by getLatestPrice.
The oracle timestamp timeStampETH only has a non-zero completeness check (no staleness bound), gating the return value.
The oracle timestamp timeStampUSD only has a non-zero completeness check (no staleness bound), gating the return value.
External call to the admin contract happens inside addPriceFeed's guard; it is a view call so it cannot mutate state or reenter.
External oracle call is made inside getLatestPrice; a view call, so reentrancy is not exploitable but the result is untrusted.
Second external oracle call inside getLatestPrice; view call returning untrusted, potentially stale data.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor-only parameter that is immediately consumed to initialize the admin state variable.
Only used to push a new oracle into the priceFeed array inside addPriceFeed.
Bounds-checked index used solely to select the oracle queried by getLatestPrice.
Intermediate oracle answer that is directly inserted into the price multiplication/division expression.
Temporary holder of the oracle updatedAt value read by the priceFeed oracle call.
Intermediate ETH/USD oracle answer that is directly inserted into the price multiplication/division expression.
Temporary holder of the ETH/USD oracle updatedAt value read by the oracle call.
